floorPlans.note: The published figures include terrace, pool or balcony space as shown on each plan. The Billionaire Sky Penthouse total applies to both levels together.

review.gallery: Nine matching original renders from Binghatti’s branded site. The lead image shows the entire tower with its crown and base.
review.location: The official brochure gives the regional view. Nine older approximate routes were followed on page 21 of the Binghatti document available via OPR. The official branded page’s general contact link resolves to a sales boutique and was excluded as a project pin.
review.floorPlans: Eight unit-level sheets and one tower elevation in the official plan book. The corresponding sheets in the 68-page official brochure show matching totals. The live property listings can describe other measurements and were kept separate.

unavailable: A confirmed entrance coordinate and the original retail, podium and amenity floor schedule were not established. The developer’s listing provides a place-name map.
